title: เลือกโลกภาพ — มือที่ 2
question: มือเดิมถูกตัดออกแล้ว ทุกทางเลือกยังคงฟิลด์และการตั้งค่าครบ

options.label: Racecard
options.thesis: Each hedge unit is a runner: cloth number, starting-price chips, scratched if unpaired.
options.viewport: A paper card, not a dark dashboard: P/L as the day’s SP in black condensed type; units as runner rows with red SCRATCHED for unpaired.
options.risk: Can look novelty-sport if the paper texture is louder than the numbers.

raised.raise: No card shells: runners sit on ruled paper, never rounded tiles.
The P/L numeral owns the field; everything else is small type.
One action ink only: refresh, snapshot, and save share a single saturated press color.
Snapshot is a test-strip: a band of the marked P/L, not a ghost button.
Cut gaps: air between units, not stacked stone slabs.
End-label grid: unit header is name / pairs / P/L in three cells.

options.label: Approach Plate
options.thesis: The book as a procedure plate: boxed fields, magenta course, black minima.
options.viewport: Title block with P/L as the minima; units as procedure strips with frequencies (lots) and missed-approach (unpaired).
options.risk: Aviation notation can feel coded until the boxes teach the scan.

options.label: Fac Catalog
options.thesis: Matte black field, one white P/L plot, units as fac numbers decoded on focus.
options.viewport: Vast black, a stacked pulse from live P/L, unit index as FAC-01…; hover decodes the color strip to WD/DP.
options.case: Holds identification for a night desk; loses clarity because encoding labels as color fights a money blotter.
options.risk: Looks like a music brand if the pulse is decorative.

options.label: Warm consumer app
options.case: This is the category the brief asked to leave; it would look like a nicer version of now.
options.kept: One action color; thumb-reachable primary controls.

options.label: Cracktro Queue
options.viewport: Ivory P/L on a void, no boxes.
options.case: A settings form cannot lose enclosure; operators do not identify with a cracktro.
options.kept: Refuse rounded card shells; rank by stillness and weight.

canonCard.label: Dark ops dashboard
canonCard.thesis: Stone cards, centered P/L, indigo — the look you already have.
canonCard.viewport: Centered hero metric and stacked unit panels.
